summary_en: Cancellation of all treasury shares acquired under May 13, 2026 buyback authorization (upper limit 1.5M shares, 0.6% of S/O). Effective date August 31, 2026. Final share count and cancellation date to be confirmed upon acquisition completion.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On June 17, 2026, Kokusai Electric's board of directors resolved to cancel all treasury shares acquired under the May 13, 2026 share buyback authorization. The buyback program authorized acquisition of up to 1.5 million shares (0.6% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) at a total outlay ceiling of 5.3 billion yen via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between May 14 and July 31, 2026. The cancellation will become effective on August 31, 2026. The company will announce the final number of shares cancelled and the precise effective date once the acquisition is completed. As of May 31, 2026, the company held 4.46 million treasury shares against 233.65 million shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
